mapper.sql: select repair_id, community_id, owner_id, repair_title, repair_content, repair_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, worker_id, assign_time, finish_time from pms_repair
mapper.select:
select r.repair_id, r.community_id, r.owner_id, r.repair_title, r.repair_content, r.repair_status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.worker_id, r.assign_time, r.finish_time, u.nick_name as worker_name, o.owner_name as owner_name, c.community_name as community_name from pms_repair r left join sys_user u on r.worker_id = u.user_id left join pms_owner o on r.owner_id = o.owner_id left join pms_community c on r.community_id = c.community_id
and r.repair_title like concat('%', #{repairTitle}, '%') and r.repair_status = #{repairStatus} and r.worker_id = #{workerId} and r.owner_id = #{ownerId}

select r.repair_id, r.community_id, r.owner_id, r.repair_title, r.repair_content, r.repair_status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.worker_id, r.assign_time, r.finish_time, u.nick_name as worker_name, o.owner_name as owner_name, c.community_name as community_name from pms_repair r left join sys_user u on r.worker_id = u.user_id left join pms_owner o on r.owner_id = o.owner_id left join pms_community c on r.community_id = c.community_id where r.repair_id = #{repairId}
